description:
Internal Sales Executive

Nottingham 29,000 - 31,000 + Annual Profit Share Bonus

Full Time Permanent Monday to Friday Office-Based

Develop Your Sales Skills with a Successful HVAC Distribution Business

Are you working in sales, customer service or a trade environment and looking for an opportunity to develop your career?

We're recruiting an Internal Sales Executive to join a successful specialist HVAC wholesaler in Nottingham, offering a competitive salary, annual profit share and the opportunity to build a long-term career within an established business.

Whether you already have internal sales experience or are looking to take the next step from a customer-facing role, this is an opportunity to develop your commercial skills, learn about a specialist industry and become part of an experienced, close-knit team.

About the Business

Our client is an established specialist HVAC wholesaler supplying heating, ventilation and air conditioning products to trade and commercial customers.

The business has enjoyed significant growth in recent years and continues to develop its customer base. As part of a larger UK group, it offers the stability of an established organisation alongside the friendly working environment of a local team.

The Role

Working within the internal sales team, you'll be responsible for supporting customers, preparing quotations and proactively identifying opportunities to develop sales.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Building relationships with existing trade and commercial customers
- Handling sales enquiries via telephone and email
- Preparing quotations and following opportunities through to order
- Proactively identifying opportunities to develop existing accounts and generate new business
- Working closely with external sales colleagues to support customers
- Developing your product knowledge across the HVAC range
- Providing knowledgeable customer service and sales support

About You

We're looking for someone with a positive attitude, good communication skills and an interest in developing their career within sales.

You'll ideally have:
- Some experience in sales, customer service, retail, trade counter or a similar customer-facing role
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive, commercially minded approach
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Enthusiasm for learning new products and developing industry knowledge
- A genuine interest in building a long-term career in internal sales

Previous experience in HVAC, plumbing and heating, technical products or wholesale would be advantageous, but isn't essential. Your attitude, reliability and willingness to learn are just as important as your previous experience.

What's on Offer?
- 29,000 - 31,000 starting salary, depending on experience
- Annual Profit Share Bonus
- 25 days' holiday plus Bank Holidays
- Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm
- Opportunity to develop valuable B2 B sales and account management experience
- Specialist HVAC product knowledge and industry experience
- Friendly, experienced team and established customer base
- Long-term career stability within a successful business

Apply Today

If you're looking to develop your sales career and want to join an established business where you can learn, build customer relationships and become an important part of the team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Nottingham (NG2) Office-based Permanent, full-time Salary

About the Company

Our client is a long-established manufacturer and supplier of precision instrumentation and industrial products, serving a loyal customer base of distributors, OEMs and end users across the UK and Europe. Their range includes pressure gauges and accessories, air preparation equipment and a wide selection of electrical test and connection products.

The Role

Due to continued growth, our client is looking for a proactive Internal Sales Executive to join their office-based sales team. The focus of the role is outbound business development: building a pipeline by calling new, existing and lapsed customers, understanding their requirements and converting opportunities into orders.

You will be the first point of contact for many customers, so confidence on the phone and the ability to build relationships quickly are essential. An electrical or technical background would be a real advantage, as you will be helping customers choose the right products for their application. Full product training will be provided.

Product Range
- Pressure gauges and accessories, including diaphragm seals, snubbers, siphons and isolation valves.
- Air preparation equipment, including filters, regulators, lubricators and related pneumatic components.
- Electrical products, including test clips, test leads, connectors, battery clamps and insulators.

Key Responsibilities
- Make a high volume of proactive outbound calls to new, existing and lapsed customers to generate new business.
- Identify and qualify new opportunities, and build and manage a healthy sales pipeline.
- Reactivate dormant accounts and grow spend with existing customers through cross-selling and upselling across the full product range.
- Handle inbound enquiries by phone and email, understanding customer requirements and recommending suitable products.
- Prepare accurate quotations and follow them up proactively to convert them into orders.
- Process orders and keep customers informed on pricing, stock and delivery.
- Keep CRM records up to date with all calls, quotes, opportunities and customer information.
- Work closely with the technical, customer service and field sales teams to deliver an excellent customer experience.
- Work towards weekly and monthly targets for calls, quotations and sales.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven experience in an internal sales, telesales or business development role, ideally in a B2 B environment.
- Confident making outbound calls and comfortable generating new business.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a professional telephone manner.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy when preparing quotations and processing orders.
- Organised, self-motivated and target-driven.
- Competent with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

Desirable
- An electrical background, whether through qualifications, an apprenticeship or previous work as an electrician or in electrical wholesale or distribution.
- Experience selling technical, engineering or industrial products.
- Knowledge of instrumentation, pneumatics or electrical test and connection products.
- Experience selling to distributors, OEMs or trade customers.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm, with an earlier finish on Fridays. The role is fully office-based in Nottingham.

Recruitment Sales Consultant

£30,000 basic salary + commission

Fresh Start Recruitment UK Limited is an established, independent recruitment agency with over 22 years experience supporting businesses across the industrial, commercial and engineering sectors.

We re looking for a confident, ambitious and personable Recruitment Sales Consultant to join our established team and play an important part in the continued growth of the business, to start in the New Year.

The role for a Recruitment Sales Consultant itself is primarily focused on business development and sales. You ll be responsible for identifying new opportunities, contacting prospective clients, developing existing relationships and ultimately winning new business.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include making sales calls to new and existing businesses, identifying potential clients and opportunities, speaking with business owners and decision-makers, arranging and attending face-to-face meetings, developing long-term client relationships and growing our existing client base.

What matters much more to us is your personality, attitude and determination.

You need to be ambitious, resilient and motivated by achieving results.

We re looking for someone who enjoys talking to people, has natural confidence, is commercially minded and genuinely wants to succeed.

In return, we offer a £30,000 basic salary plus commission, with the opportunity to earn more as you develop your client base and achieve results.

Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm.

Holiday entitlement is 20 days plus 8 bank holidays, increasing to 25 days plus 8 bank holidays following successful completion of probation.

You will need a full driving licence and own transport, be comfortable travelling locally to attend client meetings.

If you re confident, ambitious and resilient, enjoy meeting people and have the determination to make things happen, we d like to hear from you.

If you think you could be the right fit for Fresh Start Recruitment UK Limited, send us your CV and tell us a little about yourself and why this role appeals to you.
